# A generated host under `if shown` runs while `shown` holds: the timer bumps n
# on each of its first three ticks, hiding the bar on the second, and on the
# fourth shows it again and then bumps n. While hidden the bar prints nothing
# (no n=2, no n=3 as it happens), and coming back it starts again and prints
# the line as it now is before the write after it -- its gen.emit's effects
# are mounted and unmounted with the branch, on both hosts.
#
# testdata/emit_family_under_if.txtar is the code.

[!headless] skip 'needs the headless compositor go tool verify provides'

[gtk4] sngl build --lang go --platform gtk4 -o gtk4 .
[gtk4] exec ./gtk4/app
[gtk4] cmp stdout want.txt

sngl build --lang go --platform fyne -o fyne .
exec ./fyne/app
cmp stdout want.txt

-- want.txt --
start
n=0
n=1
start
n=3
n=4
-- family.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"

component block build.family

component text(full string) block

component bar(blocks ...component block) root

struct Entry {
    full string
}

#[go.native("fmt", "fmt.Print")]
func print(s string)

func encode(members list<Entry>) string {
    var parts list<string> = []
    for var e = members {
        parts.push(e.full)
    }
    return parts.join("|")
}

component block[go.language] {
    gen.emit(
        render=encode,
        @start(members) {
            print("start\n")
        },
        @change(line) {
            print(line + "\n")
        },
    )
}

component text[go.language] {
    gen.node(value=Entry{full=full})
}
-- app.sngl --
import go "sngl:language/go"
import time "sngl:time"
import ui "sngl:ui"

#[go.native("os", "os.Exit")]
func exit(code int)

var (
    shown = true
    n = 0
    ticks = 0
)

time.timer(interval=200ms, @tick {
    ticks += 1
    if ticks == 2 {
        shown = false
    }
    if ticks == 4 {
        shown = true
    }
    if ticks == 5 {
        exit(0)
    }
    if ticks < 4 {
        n += 1
    }
    if ticks == 4 {
        n += 1
    }
})

if shown {
    bar {
        text(full="n={n}")
    }
}

ui.window(title="Main") {
    ui.text(value="{n}")
}
